kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستأثر (form X)
# أَسْتَأْثِرُ (ʔastaʔṯiru) /ʔas.taʔ.θi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# أَسْتَأْثِرَ (ʔastaʔṯira) /ʔas.taʔ.θi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# أَسْتَأْثِرْ (ʔastaʔṯir) /ʔas.taʔ.θir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
